headline: The arena heats up: stalemate cover now rots
lede: Arena Archery's oldest honest gap — defensive duels parking behind walls of stuck arrows — got its answer: fifteen seconds without a hit and the arena goes HOT. Stuck cover rots at half lifetime until first blood, so hoarding barricades stops being a winning schedule. Honest matches never feel it: the autopilot's demo replays byte-identical, tempo untouched.

notes.text: #2377 shipped (PR #2382): dry-spell heat rule, glowing rattling shafts, ember vignette, rumble and cool-down sounds, red HUD timer, and an attract line teaching it. Live at /retrogames/arena-archery.

archerycheck is at 164 checks with ten mutants dying by name — the two new ones (no-heat, heat-rot off) prove the gate and the drain are both load-bearing; the browser drive now pixels-proves the fire (hot cover measured red where cool cover was amber).

The archeryplay SPACE-phase red on main got diagnosed and filed for QA (#2381): the idle test player gets killed by the flat-shot bot right as the draw phase samples — harness timing, not game behaviour. Polish pass for the heat rule filed as #2385.
